decisive_items: Hypovascular myxoid lesion composed of loosely arranged spindle and stellate cells
No epithelial components, mitoses, or atypical cell-shape features
response.rationale: Neurofibroma best fits the S100-positive, hypocellular myxoid spindle/stellate lesion without epithelial differentiation or malignancy. Medulloepitheliomas otherwise require primitive neuroepithelial/ciliary epithelial architecture, which the histologic and cytologic findings do not support.

rejected.why: Ciliary body location is nonspecific, and the lesion lacks the epithelial, primitive neuroepithelial rosette/tube-like appearance typically seen in medulloepithelioma; vitreous cytology is also negative for malignant cells.
